summary: Independent adversarial review of E1546 (build a95876d) on stand test2. healthz confirmed build_ref/commit a95876da78b26233045cd4d54df8b712756675af and gate_bundle_digest sha256:ff34ca00...; served /app.js, /app.css and /login|/register|/notes HTML are byte-identical (sha256) to the a95876d worktree. Auth: unauth GET/POST/DELETE /api/notes* -> 401 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer, checked before method/query. Owner scope: q only narrows (ListNotes(UserID) first); cross-user q=alpha/gamma -> [] for the other user; cross-user DELETE -> 404 indistinguishable from missing. Query semantics live-verified: empty/whitespace/+ -> all notes; no-match and zero-note users -> [] (never null); 512-byte q -> 200, 513 -> 400 'query too long'; encoding classes (%2B, %20, +, Cyrillic, emoji, HTML, quotes, invalid %%, NUL, control bytes, ampersand) all -> 200, no panic/500. POST text limit 4096 bytes and 2MB body cap enforced (400). Method handling 405/404 envelopes consistent. UI: no XSS sinks (textContent/setAttribute only; no innerHTML/eval/document.write); no new dead-end states (load-error no-retry nuance is pre-existing f-v3). 0 critical/high confirmed. 1 new low (RT-E1546-1: sessionStorage search query survives a re-login without Logout and leaks the previous account's query text to the next account in the same tab) and 2 new info (RT-E1546-2 NUL-in-URI answered by nginx with an HTML 400 instead of the JSON envelope; RT-E1546-3 /api 301-redirected by nginx). E1688's RT-08 reconfirmed live (0021/+21 reach the owner-scoped store layer; no oracle impact); RT-09/RT-10/RT-11 remain info/design-accepted.

findings.title: Search query persists across account switches when re-authenticating without Logout (sessionStorage not cleared on login overwrite)
findings.evidence: web/app.js: initNotes() restores SEARCH_KEY only when a token is present; removal happens on no-token, 401 and logout paths, but not when /api/login overwrites TOKEN_KEY with a new account's token. Repro: A on /notes types query 'confidential topic' -> input event writes sessionStorage['notebook.search']; user navigates manually to /login (no Logout click); logs in as B; /notes restores and pre-fills 'confidential topic' in B's session. SEARCH-E2E-8 covers only the no-token path. No note data leaks (filter applies to B's own notes only); the exposed value is the query string. Non-blocking; recommend clearing SEARCH_KEY on successful login or keying it per user.

findings.title: NUL byte in URI is rejected at the nginx edge with an HTML 400 instead of the app's JSON envelope
findings.evidence: DELETE /api/notes/21%00 -> nginx '400 Bad Request' HTML page (app never reached; Go's net/http and RFC 3986 both reject NUL in paths). Edge-layer guard, no security impact, cosmetic envelope deviation on RFC-invalid input.

findings.title: GET /api is 301-redirected by nginx to /api/ (then 404 JSON)
findings.evidence: curl /api -> 301 Moved Permanently (nginx HTML) -> /api/ -> 404 {"error":"not found"}. Edge cosmetic deviation from 'unknown /api/* -> 404 JSON'; no traversal or leak (traversal probe /api/notes/%2e%2e -> cleaned -> 404 JSON).

findings.title: DELETE id accepts Atoi alternate forms (0027, +27) as the same note
findings.evidence: Live on a95876d: DELETE /api/notes/0021 -> 404 (parsed as 21, owner-scoped store lookup ran), /api/notes/+21 -> 404, /api/notes/-21 -> 404, vs /api/notes/21abc -> 400 invalid id. Owner-scoped re-check keeps it non-escalating: canonical/foreign probes gave identical 204/404 answers, so no oracle beyond what the canonical form already reveals. Reconfirmed from E1688, unchanged.

findings.title: Unbounded per-user note count (self-DoS, pre-existing, in-memory)
findings.evidence: AddNote has no per-user cap; ListNotes is O(all notes) per request. In-memory app, no persistence, no external victim. Known since E1688, unchanged by this feature (search adds per-note ToLower work, see RT-10).

findings.title: Case-insensitivity uses per-rune strings.ToLower on q and every note text per request
findings.evidence: handleNotes: strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(q)) + ToLower per note per request; allocation cost proportional to note count. Consistent ASCII behaviour verified live (BETA -> beta match); no full Unicode folding (by design). Performance nuance only.

findings.title: UI search filters the cached notes array loaded at page load
findings.evidence: filterNotes() runs client-side over notes[] with no request per keystroke (spec core.md §3: 'client-side, no request per keystroke'); notes created elsewhere are not reflected until reload. By design; delete-404 triggers loadNotes() reload; stale-query path covered by SEARCH-E2E-8.
